result:
Looking at this qlang documentation and the tasks, I need to write pipeline queries for each scenario. Let me work through them carefully, understanding the key concepts:

- Filters apply conditions to elements
- `at` reads softly (returns null if missing), `/` reads strictly (fails if missing)
- `if` takes a condition group and two branches
- `*` applies steps to each element
- `groupBy` groups values by a key
- Failures pass through `|` and `*` until caught by `!|`

R1: filter for active users, with address (not null), and city "berlin" (case-insensitive), return sorted names

R2: average age of users with numeric age values, rounded to 2 decimals

R3: for paid orders, group by customer and sum qty*price across items, rounded to 2 decimals

R4: count open issues by assignee login, using "unassigned" for null assignees

R5: top 3 open issues by comment count (descending), then by issue number (ascending)

R6: distinct package names with "^" version prefix from either dependencies section

R7: distinct paths that returned status 500+

R8: average duration (in ms) for GET requests, rounded to nearest integer

R9: average salary by department (ignoring empty salaries), rounded to 1 decimal

R10: distinct lowercased skills across all employees

R11: DB_* keys with prefix removed and lowercased, values trimmed

R12: enabled services as array of {name, url}, sorted by name

R13: purchase statistics with total, user count, and refund check

R14: strings appearing more than once (case-insensitive), lowercased

R1: filter ~(if (/active) ~(if (at :address | ne null) ~(/address | at :city | coalesce "unknown" | lower | eq "berlin") ~(false)) ~(false)) | * /name | sort

R2: * (at :age) | filter ~(type | eq ::number) | avg | round 2

R3: filter ~(/status | eq "paid") | groupBy ~(/customer) | * (* /items | * (mulOf /qty /price) | sum | round 2)

R4: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | groupBy ~(at :assignee | if (ne null) ~(/login) ~("unassigned")) | * count

R5: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 | * /number

R6: [(/ dependencies | entries | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") | * /0) (/devDependencies | entries | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") | * /0)] | flat | distinct | sort

R7: split "\n" | * (split " " | if (count | eq 5) ~(if (/3 | parseJson | gte 500) ~(/2) ~(null)) ~(null)) | filter ~(ne null) | distinct | sort

R8: split "\n" | filter ~(split " " | /0 | eq "GET") | * (split " " | /4 | split "m" | first | parseJson) | avg | round 0

R9: split "\n" | drop 1 | * (split "," | {:name /0 :dept /1 :salary /2 :skills /3}) | filter ~(/salary | ne "") | groupBy ~(/dept) | * (* /salary | * parseJson | avg | round 1)

R10: split "\n" | drop 1 | * (split "," | /3 | split ";") | flat | * lower | filter ~(ne "") | distinct | sort

R11: split "\n" | filter ~(startsWith "#" | not) | filter ~(ne "") | * (split "=" 2 | {((/0 | trim | drop 3 | lower) (/1 | trim))})

R12: /services | entries | filter ~(/1/enabled | coalesce false) | * {:name /0 :url ((/1/protocol | append "://") | append /1/host | append ":" | append (/1/port | coalesce 80 | print))} | sort ~(/name)

R13: {total (filter ~(/type | eq "purchase") | * (at /meta/amount | coalesce 0) | sum | round 2) users (filter ~(/type | eq "purchase") | * /user | distinct | count) hasRefund (any ~(/type | lower | eq "refund"))}

R14: groupBy ~(lower) | filter ~(count | gt 1) | keys | sort
